name: InfiMaker K1
notes: Kickstarter campaign ended 26.09.2026 (funded, ~800 backers). Price is the Kickstarter Late Pledge for the base K1 kit (creator-stated US$5,699, shown on Kickstarter as HK$44,712; incl. basic material kit, 6 mm bit set, tool kit; shipping extra; est. delivery Feb 2027). Super Early Bird was US$5,199; stated MSRP US$9,499. Trunnion B -30° to 110°, C 360°; max workpiece 120x120x120 mm (5-axis), 170x150x150 mm (3+2), 220x150x150 mm (3-axis). ATC has 6 stations = 5 tools + ruby probe. Feed = max rapid; max cutting feed 2,500 mm/min. InfiFlow high-pressure water coolant is an optional add-on.

accessories.name: InfiFlow Water Coolant System
accessories.description: Compact high-pressure water coolant system with automatic operation and multi-stage filtration for machining stainless steel and titanium.

accessories.name: Zero-Lag Handwheel
accessories.description: Battery-free handwheel for micron-level tool setting and manually stepping through G-code to verify 5-axis toolpaths.

accessories.name: V-Groove Vise Jaw Kit
accessories.description: V-groove jaws, interchangeable with the standard vise jaws, for securely gripping round stock (includes a 50x100 mm aluminum round bar).

accessories.name: Tool Kit
accessories.description: Metric hex keys, socket wrench, safety goggles, chip brush and bit installation tool for setup and daily operation.
